section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results of independent-samples t-tests examining sex differences across key variables with Bonferroni correction (p = .006). Women were significantly older and had higher BMIs than men, and reported significantly lower body appreciation, body pride, and body image flexibility scores, with no sex differences found on body acceptance from others, emotional well-being, or psychological well-being. All subsequent analyses were conducted separately by sex.
